title_en: MG-T pretensioned precast bridge beam system
producer: Pekabex / Mosty Gdańsk sp. z o.o.

locators.sections: PDF p3 (printed p2): 'A–A przekrój podporowy', 'B–B przekrój przypodporowy', 'C–C przekrój przęsłowy' (span section implemented)
locators.table: PDF p6 (printed p8): długość całkowita Lc, wysokość H, objętość betonu V, masa M

scaled_dimensions_mm.scale: vector outline of C–C scaled so the drawn top width equals the printed 2390 (14.346 mm/pt); drawn web 222 (printed 220), drawn depth 1309 (≈ MG-T30, H = 1300)

geometry_notes: Only the span (przęsłowy, C–C) section is modelled; the 450 mm-web support and near-support sections (A–A, B–B) are excluded.
Printed: 2390 top width, 220 span web, H per table. Every other dimension is scaled from the vector outline in the PDF (to-scale drawing, apparently H ≈ 1300) and rounded to 5 mm: an ESTIMATE.
All sizes assumed to share the flanges; only the web height changes with H (catalogue: 'Zmiana wysokości belki następuje co ok. 3m').
Fillet radii are fitted to the drawn Bézier corners (tangent lengths), rounded.
Check: V/Lc (mean area incl. support zones) / span-section area = 0.95–1.08; the ratio steps between MG-T24 and MG-T27 (0.97 → 1.04), which may mean thicker parts on longer beams; unresolved.
